== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The original-layout virtual slip prints a title bullet. The remastered Defensive Shield slip omits it. This comparison records the printed title marks. It does not establish a change in the effective number of copies that could be deployed. Both keep the same combat use, cost, eligible characters and Deep Hatred condition.
